Eknath Bajirao Kale And Others vs The State Of Maharashtra
And Others on 3 February, 2026

Author: Vibha Kankanwadi
Bench: Vibha Kankanwadi
 In The High Court Of Judicature At Bombay
 Bench At Aurangabad
 Writ Petition No. 156 Of 2026
 Eknath Bajirao Kale And Others
 Versus
 The State Of Maharashtra And Others
Mr. D. K. Thote, Advocate for petitioners

entities.text:
High Court Of Judicature At Bombay
 Bench At Aurangabad
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
Ms. N. B. Kamble, Agp for respondent-State
 Coram : Smt. Vibha Kankanwadi &
 Hiten S. Venegavkar, Jj.

DATE : 03rd February, 2026 PER COURT :-
1. Heard learned Advocate for the petitioner.
2. Learned AGP waives notice for all respondents.
3. Petition has been filed for direction to the respondents to pay compensation as per the award dated 28.02.2022 along with interest.
4. Learned AGP files communication which is taken on record by marking Exhibit 'X'.

In the said communication, the respondents are accepting about the award passed in respect of the land belonging to respondent Nos. 2 to 4 and it is stated that the demand has been made in respect of the awarded amount to the Government.

As regards petitioner No. 1 is concerned, it is stated that for Gat No. 269 earlier the 910-WP-156-2026.odt 1 of 3 7/12 extract stood in the name of Eknath Bajirao Kale so also in Annexure '16', his name was there and, therefore, it was restricted in the award, however, when online 7/12 extract has been seen, it could get the name of one Ankush Nagorao Tithe in place of Eknath Bajirao Kale and, therefore, name of Ankush Nagorao Tithe has been taken in Annexure 'E' of the award.

The communication also mentions that when the notice was given under Section 21(4) of the Right to Fare Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013 (for Short "the Act") on 18.10.2021.

sentences.text:
Now the communication Exhibit 'X'
speaks about dispute in respect of one land i.e., Gat No. 269 and as regards the other petitioners are concerned, as aforesaid, the possession is accepted.
When the lands were acquired, notification under Section 11 of the Act was issued on 03.08.2020.
It is surprising that till date the compensation has not been paid.

We therefore, direct the respondents to deposit the amount of compensation on or before 11.03.2026 as per following chart :
910-WP-156-2026.odt 2 of 3
Sr . Name
Amount of Compensation  No.

1 Bhanudas Bajirao Kale Rs. 9,00,000/-
 2 Eknath Bajirao Kale (for Land Rs. 9,00,000/-
Gat No. 267)
3 Gyanaji Punjaram Rs. 3,00,000/-

4 Uddhav Punjaram and Gyanaji Rs. 16,00,000/-
 Punjarama 5.
There shall be affidavit-in-reply on behalf of respondents to be filed on or before 13.03.2026.

Copy of the same be given to other side, in advance.
6.

We are making it clear even at this stage that for unnecessary delays with the state exchequer is taxed, we may direct the respondent No. 2 to hold an inquiry and recover the interest amount which was required to be paid due to the negligence on the part of such officers.
7. Place the matter for further consideration on 23.03.2026.

(Hiten S. Venegavkar, J.) (Smt. Vibha Kankanwadi, J.)
